flows.name: Canonical invoice source valuation
steps: Create or edit a normal subcontractor invoice line with a stable SOV or approved change-order source
Canonicalize schedule, commitment, and change values from the database source
Reject submission when the invoice source set is incomplete, duplicated, stale, or overbilled
flows.expectedOutcome: Every submitted invoice contains each current source exactly once with authoritative values

flows.name: Editable invoice synchronization and reopen
steps: Change a commitment SOV or approved change order
Reconcile missed source changes when an invoice returns from review to Draft
flows.expectedOutcome: Editable invoices follow current sources without rewriting submitted or accounting history

flows.name: Fail closed on destructive or signed edge cases
steps: Support deductive approved change orders with signed billing
Block reopen when removing a source would erase billed or retained financial activity
flows.expectedOutcome: Races, deductible COs, and billed source removal remain financially consistent and explicit

claims.description: Invoice sources and values are canonical and complete before review
Invalid schedules, deletion races, and billed source removal fail loudly
Correctness, React, and security reviewers approve the final implementation
